critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines — consider splitting into auth/events/payments/uploads routers for maintainability
_compute_taken can return duplicates if a seat is both held and booked (not a bug, but inefficient); could de-dup before returning
payment_status endpoint mutates DB on every poll — fine for now, but races possible if two pollers hit 'paid' simultaneously (idempotency partially handled via 'processed' flag)
Path traversal sanitisation `filename.replace('..','').replace('/','')` works but `os.path.basename` would be more idiomatic
seed_data_creation: Created 1 booking-style Stripe session + 1 plan-upgrade Stripe session (both unpaid, will expire). 2 seat_holds for evt-neon-symphony seats (5,3) and (5,4). 1 small PNG upload in db.uploads.
